fixture_builder: Each eval runs in a disposable git repo with a bare origin, built from a copy of docs/ by evals/build_fixtures.sh (usage: build_fixtures.sh <repo-root> <output-dir> <scenario-name>...). The builder snapshots each fixture's Git state; after a run, evals/check_state.sh compare <output-dir>/<scenario>/w verifies it independently. In each sandbox the bare repo <output-dir>/<scenario>/w/origin.git stands in for https://github.com/Atlantech-project/project-ai.git and the run prompt must say so. Scenario setup: AI-010 and AI-001 are merged/DONE on develop unless noted.

assertions: A local branch named feature/AI-014-* exists and is checked out
The new branch points at the develop tip (no new commits created)
Nothing was pushed to origin (origin heads unchanged)
No files under src/ were created or modified
docs/tasks/status/AI-014.md exists
The response names the files actually inspected
